title: 早上一点

lines.text: 小雨第一次去埃塞俄比亚出差，要去亚的斯亚贝巴郊区的一家合作工厂谈一批新订单。
lines.py: Xiǎo yǔ dì yī cì qù āi sāi é bǐ yà chū chāi, yào qù yà de sī yà bèi bā jiāo qū de yì jiā hé zuò gōng chǎng tán yì pī xīn dìng dān.
lines.en: It's Xiaoyu's first business trip to Ethiopia: she's going to a partner factory on the outskirts of Addis Ababa to discuss a new order.

lines.en: She doesn't reach the hotel until ten at night, and she's barely put her bags down when the factory's driver phones and says in English, "Tomorrow morning at one o'clock, I'll pick you up outside the hotel."

lines.text: 原来，埃塞俄比亚人平时说时间有自己的算法：一天不是从半夜开始算，而是从早上六点天亮的时候开始算。

lines.en: It turns out Ethiopians usually tell the time their own way: the day isn't counted from midnight, but from six in the morning, when it gets light.
